<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I am back for a new session, but I believe my work is done. The task is complete when the booking has been created and the confirmation email has been sent. I have created the booking, and I've asked Brad to send the email. I'll check the workspace to see if Brad has confirmed that the email has been sent. There are no new entries, which is unexpected. I would have expected Brad to confirm that he sent the email.

Given that I'm in a new session, I should probably check in with Brad to make sure he has sent the email. It's possible he hasn't seen my last message yet.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
